name: yarr
description: Yet another RSS reader, small and fast with a clean three-pane look

paths.name: Data
paths.description: yarr's database with your feeds and articles. Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: yarr web app, published on host as 6885

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: YARR_ADDR
variables.description: Where yarr listens inside the container. Leave it as it is.

variables.name: YARR_DB
variables.description: yarr's database file, inside the data folder.

variables.name: YARR_AUTH
variables.description: A login as username:password. Leave blank when you use yarr at http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:6885, because yarr's login cookie only works over https. Set it only behind a reverse proxy with your own domain.
